verdict.rationale: Poke is itself a built-in AI assistant (accessible via Messages/WhatsApp/Telegram) that users delegate tasks to via natural conversation—managing email, calendar, reminders, integrations, recipes, even booking real-world services—demonstrating clear task delegation and agentic action-taking. Docs and release notes give rich, first-party coverage of this core capability across many domains. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond the prompt-injection anecdote confirming reliability of delegated task execution.
